idea: A block sinks until the liquid it pushes aside weighs as much as it does; a block denser than the liquid never gets there, so it sinks.

parameters.name: density
parameters.why: From cork-light wood to twice as dense as water.

parameters.name: liquid
parameters.why: From oil through fresh water to very salty water.

moves: The block drops into the tank, bobs and settles with its bottom on the dashed line, or sinks to the floor; the arrows show its weight and the push of the liquid.
